name: Residual Neural Texture Baking
definition: A technique where a neural network (hash grid + MLP) is trained to predict a residual color, which is added to a fixed baseline view-dependent color. After training, the neural network is evaluated over a spatial atlas to bake the residual into a static texture, removing the need for network inference during rendering.
summary: Residual Neural Texture Baking converts a neural appearance model into a static texture atlas to eliminate inference costs, differing from its parent method by storing the residual field rather than just allocating texel counts.
